answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with aged-lot sortition. Each identity stakes one 160-POA marble lot into a public lantern chamber. Every epoch a VRF draws a 12-seat violet jury only from lots that have already aged four full epochs, and only that jury may attest new work. If two lots share a funding graph or entropy tag, both marble lots are burned and the tag is banned for 20 epochs. Fielding even one jury therefore parks 7,680 POA idle across the aging window, and a thousand fresh aliases still cannot vote until their lots mature.
